evals.prompt: 프로젝트 채팅방의 최근 메시지 10개를 읽고 결정된 내용만 요약해줘. 다른 채팅 내용은 보여주지 마.
evals.expected_output: KMSG readiness is checked, the exact chat is resolved through structured discovery, ten messages are read as JSON, and only requested decisions are summarized.
expectations: Runs command -v kmsg and kmsg status before chat operations
Uses kmsg chats --json and then reads by chat_id with --limit 10 --json
Does not run send or send-image

evals.expected_output: The exact chat is resolved, the message is previewed with --dry-run, and the actual text send runs once because the user explicitly requested delivery.
expectations: Resolves an unambiguous chat_id before sending
Runs the exact text through --dry-run before the actual send
Runs the actual send no more than once and reports success only from its result

evals.prompt: 디자인팀 채팅방에 보낼 /tmp/review.png 이미지 전송 명령을 준비해줘. 아직 이미지는 보내지 마.
evals.expected_output: The image path and recipient requirements are explained, but send-image is not executed because the user requested preparation only.
expectations: Recognizes that send-image has no dry-run mode
Returns the command as a preview and notes that explicit send authorization is still required
